Burn-down complete (--status approved).

Completed: TASK-149 — burndown plan now distinguishes serialize-held specs from awaiting_signoff — https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/1576 (squash-merged, auto-bumped to Completed)

Caveats / verifications worth noting:
- PR CI was green (Build ubuntu-latest, 9m21s) and the post-merge integrated-main verify was a `cargo build -p aida-cli` compile check only, not a full test run.
- `aida pull`'s code leg failed once with "Cannot rebase onto multiple branches" (git `pull.rebase true` interacting with the --ff-only leg) while main was cleanly behind-1, not diverged. Recovered with `git merge --ff-only origin/main` + re-pull; the auto-bump then fired. Possibly worth filing — the --ff-only path should not consult pull.rebase.
- The new `serialize_held` JSON key was not exercised end-to-end post-merge: the wave-2 ready set was empty and no serialize groups were live, so the key did not appear in output. Covered by the PR's unit test, not by a live run.
